title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string `s`, return the length of the longest **substring** (contiguous characters) that contains no repeated character.
constraints: s may contain letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
hints: Checking every substring for duplicates is cubic or quadratic. Think of a window that always stays duplicate-free.
When the new character is already inside the window, the left edge must move past its previous occurrence.
Store each character's last index in a map; on a repeat inside the window set left = last_index + 1, then record right - left + 1.

solution.explanation: Maintain a window [left, right] with no duplicates and a map of each character's most recent index. When s[right] was last seen at or after left, jump left to just past that index. After each step the window is valid, so update the best length. Each index is visited once, giving O(n) time and space bounded by the alphabet size.
